strings.app.title: Background Check
strings.app.subtitle: An eye on my servers
strings.toggle.stop_on_quit: Stop when I quit the app
strings.log.title: LOG
strings.log.port_open: Port {port} open (pid {pid}) — waiting for the API…
strings.log.port_busy: Refused: port {port} is held by another process (pid {pid}, {name}). I only stop what I started.
strings.log.no_port: The server did not open port {port} (see the log).
strings.log.api_slow: The port is listening but the API does not answer yet.
strings.log.already_listening: A process is already listening on port {port}.
strings.log.phase_starting: Port {port} open, the API is starting…
strings.log.tray_ready: Notification icon ready: left click = show, right click = menu.
strings.log.tray_unavailable: Notification icon unavailable: {error} — the app works without it.
strings.log.data_migrated: Data carried over from the old name: {old} copied (the original is left intact) → {new}
strings.log.autostart_migrated: "Start with Windows" carried over under the new name (the old HermesServ entry was removed)
strings.log.hide: Window minimized to the notification area — left click the icon to reopen, “Quit” to exit the app.
strings.log.quit_tray: Quit requested from the notification icon.
strings.log.stop_before_quit: Stopping the server before quitting (switch enabled).
strings.log.desktop_missing: Desktop app not found (neither Hermes.exe nor `hermes desktop`).
strings.log.desktop_already: The desktop app is already running (pid {pid}) — no second launch.
strings.log.desktop_auto: Server ready → launching the desktop app automatically.
strings.log.desktop_auto_skip: Server ready — the desktop app is already open.
strings.log.desktop_wait_remote: Server online — waiting for the desktop URL to answer before opening it ({url}).
strings.log.desktop_wait_timeout: {url} did not answer within {seconds}s — opening the desktop app anyway.
strings.log.desktop_local_mode: Desktop app set to “This computer” — opening immediately, nothing to wait for.
strings.log.desktop_no_server: Server stopped — the desktop will start its own local backend.
strings.log.intro_never_backend: I never touch the desktop backend, nor “hermes serve --stop”.
strings.log.loading_state: Status is still being read, one moment…
strings.log.hide_on_close_on: Closing the window: minimized to the notification area.
strings.log.hide_on_close_off: Closing the window: quits the app.
strings.log.no_tray_fallback: No notification icon: closing quits the app.
strings.settings.title: Settings
strings.settings.language_hint: Applies immediately to the whole interface and the log.
strings.settings.servers_hint: Each server has its own settings (Settings button in its tab).
strings.settings.no_servers: No server yet. Add one with “Add server”.
strings.settings.name: Display name
strings.settings.danger_hint: The server and its settings are removed from the configuration. Nothing else on the machine is touched.
strings.add.title: Add a server
strings.add.name_hint: Name shown in the left rail.
strings.add.error.name: Give this server a name.
strings.type.hermes.label: Hermes (dashboard)
strings.type.hermes.desc: Starts and watches the Hermes dashboard on a port, with the desktop app.
strings.field.target_hint: To watch a port on this machine, just type 127.0.0.1:5451 — or even 5451 alone. A URL replaces both the port and the check path: http://127.0.0.1:9931/v1/models. Empty = only the launched process is watched.
strings.field.label: Display name
strings.field.icon_hint: Pick an image (.png, .ico…) or an .exe/.dll: its icon replaces the tile pictogram in the sidebar. Nothing picked = the type pictogram.
strings.field.command_stop_hint: Command run when you click Stop (e.g. “lms server stop”). Empty = stop kills the launched process and its children.
strings.toggle.command_stop_external: Stop it even if started elsewhere
strings.settings.ui_scale_hint: Enlarges text, buttons and window as a whole. The window can also be resized with the mouse.
strings.settings.theme_hint: Dark, light, or "like Windows": follows the app mode chosen in Settings > Personalization > Colors, even while the app is running.
strings.field.extra_checks_hint: One per line: “name = port” or “name = URL”. E.g. gateway = 8642, health = http://127.0.0.1:8642/health
strings.status.paused_hint: No probe: resume watching in this tile's settings.
strings.settings.organise_hint: To change the order, drag a tile in the left column: a line shows where it will land.
strings.settings.enabled_hint: While paused the tile is not probed (no port, no process) but stays in the rail.
strings.settings.custom_actions_hint: Up to 3 extra buttons under the tab. Target: an http(s) address to open, or a command run as is (the service's working directory is used).
strings.settings.startup_hint: Adds or removes Background Check at Windows startup, for your account only. Nothing is written without this click.
strings.settings.tiles_hint: A tile exports to a small .tile.json file (its settings, switches, buttons and icon) and imports elsewhere. Plugins are Python folders dropped in the plugins folder: a plugin runs code, install only what you have checked.
strings.toggle.notify_on_fall: Notify if a service falls over
strings.dup.label: {label} (copy)
strings.log.autostart_failed: Start with Windows: could not write to the registry.
strings.tray.fall_text: {label} stopped. Open Background Check to read the log.
strings.tile.error.format: This file is not a Background Check tile (unknown format).
strings.tile.error.version: Tile version not supported by this application version.
strings.tile.error.type: The tile does not name a server type.
strings.tile.error.label: The tile has no name.
strings.tile.error.unknown_type: Unknown type “{type}”: install the matching plugin first.
strings.config.corrupt_text:
The configuration file could not be read ({error}). It was not deleted: it has been set aside as
{path}
strings.config.corrupt_restore:
Restore the most recent backup ({backup}, from {when})?

No = start with an empty configuration.
strings.config.corrupt_no_backup: No readable backup was found: the app starts with an empty configuration.
strings.tile.preview_intro: A tile can run commands on this PC. Check what it contains before importing it:
strings.tile.preview_none: No command: this tile only watches or opens web pages.
strings.tile.preview_autostart_off: Turned off on import (turn it back on yourself if you want): {options}
strings.tile.export_env_question:
This tile contains environment variables (often API keys or tokens). Include them in the exported file?

No = they are removed from the file.
strings.log.tile_autostart_disabled: Tile "{label}": automatic start turned off on import.
strings.output.title: Console output — {label}
strings.output.empty: No output captured: the command wrote nothing, or has not been started yet.
strings.preset.label: Quick presets
strings.preset.hint: One click fills the fields; adjust anything that does not fit. Nothing is executed.
strings.log.icon_bad: Icon not found or unreadable: {path} — the default pictogram stays.
strings.type.command.label: Watched service
strings.type.command.desc: Watches a port or URL, and can start/stop it with your commands (optional). The general-purpose type: it replaces the former “port / site to watch”.
strings.field.command_hint: Command line run when you click Start, as in a console (e.g. “python my_server.py --port 8000”). Empty = the service is only watched.
strings.field.command_env_hint: Variables passed to both the run and stop commands (one per line NAME=value, e.g. PORT=8000). Local to Background Check: nothing else uses them.
strings.log.command_restart_giveup: 3 automatic restarts failed — no more attempts (manual restart possible).
strings.log.command_already: The command is already running (pid {pid}) — no second launch.
strings.log.command_stop_refused: “{name}” (pid {pid}) is running outside Background Check: stop refused.
strings.log.command_adopted: Process found outside the app (pid {pid}, {name}) — adopted, not stopped.
strings.empty.title: No server
strings.empty.hint: Click “Add server” on the left to add the first server to watch.
strings.type.wsl.label: WSL
strings.type.wsl.desc: Windows Linux distributions. Leave the distribution empty to see them all and control each one; name one for a dedicated tile.
strings.field.wsl_distro_hint: Exact name from "wsl -l -v" (e.g. Ubuntu). Empty = every distribution, each one can be started / terminated.
strings.toggle.wsl_stop_external: Stop it even if started elsewhere
strings.log.wsl_adopted: "{name}" was already running outside the app: adopted, not stopped.
strings.log.wsl_stop_refused: "{name}" was started outside Background Check: stop refused (enable the option to allow it).
strings.type.stt.label: STT bridge (GPU)
strings.type.stt.desc: Exposes an OpenAI-compatible transcription API and forwards to whisper.cpp over Vulkan: the same model as Hermes, but on the GPU.
strings.summary.command_watch: Observation only of {target} — no start or stop command.
strings.summary.command_kill: Probe {target} · Start: {start} · Stop: the launched process (and its children)
strings.summary.command_kill_noport: No port probed · Start: {start} · Stop: the launched process (and its children)
strings.summary.hermes: Local gateway (port {local_port}) & remote web access (port {port}) — controlled independently.
strings.summary.wsl_distro: Drives the “{distro}” distribution (start, stop, shell, files).
strings.summary.wsl_all: Every distribution, each one can be started / terminated.
strings.section.command_probe_hint: Tells whether the service is up, even when started outside Background Check. A port is enough.
strings.section.command_control_hint: Leave empty to simply watch: with no command, the tab shows no start or stop button.
strings.log.stt_stopped: STT bridge stopped: port {port} is free.
strings.log.stt_already: The STT bridge is already listening.
strings.log.stt_not_running: The STT bridge was not running.
strings.log.stt_port_busy: Refused: port {port} is already held by another process. I don't override what I didn't start.
strings.log.stt_upstream_missing: Bridge started, but {upstream} does not respond: start OpenWhispr so it brings up its whisper.cpp server.
strings.log.stt_url_copied: URL copied: http://{host}:{port}/v1 — put it in Hermes' stt.openai.base_url.
strings.log.stt_inference_ok: Full path verified: upstream transcribes (real test on 0.5 s of silence).
strings.log.stt_auto_started: Automatic start: STT bridge active on {port}.
strings.field.check_url_hint: e.g. /v1/models — queries this path on the port to check the service really answers. Empty = only the port is checked.
strings.log.command_no_start: No start command configured for this server.
strings.add.error.command: Fill in at least the start command or the stop command.
strings.add.error.command_or_port: Fill in at least a port to watch, or a start / stop command.
strings.field.host_hint: Machine to watch: 127.0.0.1 for this PC, or its IP/name on the network (e.g. 192.168.1.50).
strings.field.port_hint: TCP port of the service. Optional: without a port, only the launched process is watched.
strings.field.url_hint: Address at which this service can be reached from another device (e.g. a Tailscale URL). Shown in the status banner — nothing is checked against it.
strings.field.command_workdir_hint: Directory the command runs from. Empty = the application's directory.
strings.field.phone_node_hint: Exact device name in Tailscale (phone, laptop, tablet…). Only its online/offline state is shown.
strings.settings.mcp_hint: Exposes tiles and servers to a local AI agent (e.g. Hermes) on 127.0.0.1 only. The agent can start/stop servers and edit tiles; every config write is backed up first.
strings.settings.mcp_scope: Scope: any program on this computer that knows the token can read, create, edit and drive the tiles while this server is listening. Keep the token private.
strings.mcp.status_running: Listening on {url} — a local agent can read and edit the tiles.
strings.settings.mcp_token_hint: Every MCP client must send the header "Authorization: Bearer <token>". For Hermes: paste the copied block under "mcp_servers:" in config.yaml, then /reload-mcp. Requests coming from a web page are always refused.
strings.log.mcp_token_copied: MCP token copied to the clipboard.
strings.log.mcp_hermes_copied: MCP configuration for Hermes copied (YAML block with the token).
strings.log.mcp_token_regenerated: New MCP token created: the old one no longer works, update your clients.
strings.log.hermes_gw_adopted: Local gateway already listening on {port} (pid {pid}) — adopted.
strings.log.hermes_gw_ready: Local gateway ready on {port} in {seconds} s.
strings.log.hermes_gw_stopped: Local gateway stopped: port {port} is free.
strings.overview.title: Overview
strings.deps.title: Related servers
strings.dep.tooltip: A server this tile needs. Background Check watches it (state, CPU, RAM, VRAM) without starting or stopping it. Its resources are counted separately, not in the tile's.
strings.field.deps_hint: name = target; name = target… Target: a port (11434), host:port, a URL or an executable (ollama.exe). Watched only, never started or stopped.
strings.overview.gpu_tip: Dedicated graphics memory used by all programs (Windows “GPU Adapter Memory” counters).
strings.overview.metrics_tip: Sum of the service process and its children, measured every 4 s. CPU: share of the whole machine (100% = all cores). VRAM: dedicated graphics memory (“—” when unavailable).
strings.metrics.title: Resources
strings.status.url_inactive: {url} — inactive while the service is stopped
strings.chain.missing_target: Tunnel configured, but nothing listens on port {port}: start remote access.
strings.chain.missing_tunnel: No tunnel to port {port}: the phone cannot reach the dashboard.
strings.chain.missing_remote: The public address {url} does not answer.
strings.toggle.rail_compact_hint: Names appear as tooltips on hover.
strings.toggle.global_hotkey: Ctrl+Alt+H shortcut to show the window
strings.toggle.global_hotkey_hint: Works from any application, even with the window hidden. Off by default; if another app already uses this shortcut, the log says so.
strings.settings.mcp_port_hint: Local port of the MCP server (1024–65535). After a change, update your agent's config ("Copy Hermes config" button).
strings.settings.mcp_port_invalid: Invalid port: pick a number between 1024 and 65535.
strings.log.hotkey_failed: Ctrl+Alt+H shortcut unavailable (already taken by another app?)
strings.toggle.command_auto_restart_hint: 3 attempts at most, and never after a stop requested from the app.
strings.toggle.command_autostart_hint: Runs the command when the app opens, unless the service is already listening.
strings.toggle.command_stop_external_hint: Without this option, a service started outside the app is never stopped by it.
strings.toggle.auto_desktop_hint: Launches Hermes Desktop as soon as the server answers.
strings.toggle.wsl_stop_external_hint: Without this option, a distro started outside the app is never stopped by it.
strings.toggle.notify_on_fall_hint: Windows notification when a running service stops without being asked to.
strings.preset.reset_hint: Replaces the form fields with a template's, after showing you the differences. Nothing is saved until "Save".
strings.preset.reset_question: Apply the "{preset}" template? These fields will change:
strings.preset.reset_unsaved: The form will be changed; click "Save" to keep the result.
strings.preset.reset_done: "{preset}" template applied to the form — remember to save.
strings.preset.reset_nothing: The form already matches the "{preset}" template.
strings.add.test_hint: Checks the port, address, folder and executable without launching anything.
strings.add.icon_auto: Icon taken from the executable; you can change it.
strings.test.nothing: Nothing to check for this type.
strings.welcome.title: Welcome to {app}
strings.welcome.intro: No tiles yet. Here is what was found on this PC: tick what you want to watch; nothing is created without your click.
strings.welcome.nothing: Nothing familiar found. Add a tile by hand: a command, a port to watch, an address…
strings.welcome.mcp_text: {app} exposes a local MCP server (127.0.0.1 only, token-protected): an agent such as Hermes can read service states and start or stop them. Copy the config and paste it into Hermes's config.yaml (mcp_servers section).
strings.log.welcome_created: {n} tile(s) created from the welcome screen
strings.items.title: Items
strings.field.docker_engine_hint: "Automatic" uses Docker when installed, otherwise Podman.
strings.field.docker_filter_hint: Only show containers whose name or image contains this text (e.g. "compose"). Empty = all.
strings.field.winsvc_services_hint: Service name (not the display name), e.g. "Spooler". Several services: separate them with commas; each becomes an item of the tile.
strings.items.docker_missing: Neither Docker nor Podman is installed on this PC (no "docker" or "podman" command found).
strings.items.docker_down: The engine does not answer: is Docker Desktop (or the Podman machine) running?
strings.items.docker_none: No containers (or none match the filter).
strings.items.winsvc_none: No valid service name in the tile settings.
strings.log.docker_missing: Docker / Podman not found on this PC
strings.log.winsvc_already: The service is already in the requested state
strings.log.winsvc_denied: {name}: elevation refused (UAC prompt cancelled) — nothing was done
strings.log.winsvc_uac: {name}: administrator rights needed to "{action}", asking for elevation (UAC)…
strings.status.docker_down: {engine} installed, but the engine does not answer
strings.summary.docker_all: Every container on this PC (Docker or Podman)
strings.summary.docker_filter: Containers whose name or image contains "{filter}"
strings.summary.winsvc_one: Windows service "{name}" (start / stop, elevation when needed)
strings.type.docker.label: Docker / Podman containers
strings.type.docker.desc: One item per container: start, stop, restart, logs, open the published port.
strings.type.winsvc.label: Windows service
strings.type.winsvc.desc: Start / stop one or several Windows services; elevation (UAC) is only requested when needed.
